item.title: Git, agents, and the long way here
item.description: Every workshop needs a wall to hang things on. For a long time flove built its walls out of trust in other people’s platforms — code in someone’s cloud, notes in someone’s app, publishing through someone else’s pipeline. The internet taught us that works until it doesn’t. This post is the story of flove growing its own walls: a little server that keeps the work, and a pair of hands — one human, one machine — that have been learning to build together on the other side of them.
